Ally Shield.descriptionOnly: no path: cover against one attack, behind an ally with this feat, at the table

Chairbreaker.descriptionOnly: no path: breaking its improvised weapon for damage and +4 to confirm

Destructive Persuasion.descriptionOnly: no path: Intimidate by smashing an object, its bonus by hardness

Fiendskin.descriptionOnly: resist 5 against an energy type picked from its patron's subtype with one damnation feat, 5 more with two, immunity to a picked type with three and with four (and outsider (native)); the picks and the count of damnation feats are made at the table

Maleficium.descriptionOnly: with one damnation feat; 1 more with three, metamagic a level lower with two, and caster level 2 higher for evil spells' effects with four, at the table

Reckless Moves.descriptionOnly: while using an adjacent ally with this feat as a counterweight; the –2 on those checks is the abettor's, and the DC 20 Acrobatics check is to land after switching places

Shrapnel Strike.descriptionOnly: on Strength checks to break objects that can shatter; the shards' damage and DC are at the table

Soulless Gaze.descriptionOnly: +2 more with three damnation feats; stronger fear with two, and demoralize as a swift action with four, at the table

Stunning Irruption.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are the DC and rounds of the stun it gives others

Wild Flanking.descriptionOnly: no path: bonus damage as Power Attack's while flanking with an ally with this feat, at the table
